title: The hand with means and without
odia:
ଥିଲା ହାତ ଖଲ ଖଲ
ନଥିଲା ହାତ କଲବଲ
literal_meaning: The hand with means is lively; the hand without is distressed.
meaning_odia: ହାତରେ ସମ୍ବଳ ଥିବା ଓ ନଥିବାର ଦୁଇ ଅବସ୍ଥାକୁ ଏଠାରେ ତୁଳନା କରାଯାଇଛି ବୋଲି ଆମେ ପଢ଼ୁଛୁ। ଖଲ ଖଲକୁ ଏଠାରେ ବ୍ୟାପକ ଭାବରେ ଚଞ୍ଚଳତା, କଲବଲକୁ କଷ୍ଟ ଭାବେ ବୁଝାଯାଇଛି। ସମ୍ବଳ ଥିଲେ କାମ କରିବାର ସୁବିଧା ଓ ନଥିଲେ ଅସୁବିଧା—ଏହା ଆମ ସମ୍ପାଦକୀୟ ବ୍ୟାଖ୍ୟା।
explanation: The two lines give the hand opposite conditions: animated when something is available, distressed when it is not. We read the unstated possession as means or resources, and the contrast as room to act versus the strain of shortage. “Lively” is a broad contextual rendering of ଖଲ ଖଲ; its precise expressive shade has not been independently established.
usage_example: Original imagined example: A small workshop can buy materials readily while funds are available, but struggles to keep working when payments are delayed. Someone recalls the contrast between the hand with means and the hand without.
cultural_context: The near-rhyme ଖଲ ଖଲ / କଲବଲ makes the change in condition audible. The hand provides a concrete place to imagine what one has available and what one can do with it.

witnesses.locator: Page23, fourth item beginning ଥିଲା ହାତ.
